title: KAIROS: Stateful, Context-Aware Power-Efficient Agentic Inference Serving
abstract: arXiv:2604.16682v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Power has become a central bottleneck for AI inference. This problem is becoming more urgent as agentic AI emerges as a major workload class, yet prior power-management techniques focus almost entirely on single-turn LLM serving. Our analysis shows that agentic serving behaves fundamentally differently: each request carries long-lived context that evolves across tool-interleaved turns, and lowering GPU frequency can push the system into a thrashing regime where memory pressure sharply worsens both performance and power efficiency. These observations show that power optimization for agentic serving requires rethinking.   We present KAIROS, a context-aware power optimization system for agentic AI serving. KAIROS uses agent context as a first-class control signal to jointly manage GPU frequency, per-instance concurrency, and multi-instance request placement. translated_title: KAIROS：有状态、上下文感知的高能效智能体推理服务系统
translated_abstract: 功率已成为AI推理的核心瓶颈。随着智能体AI（Agentic AI）成为一类主要的工作负载，这一问题日益紧迫，然而以往的功率管理技术几乎完全聚焦于单轮LLM服务。我们的分析表明，智能体服务的行为有着根本性的不同：每个请求都携带着在工具交错的多轮交互中不断演进的长生命周期上下文，而降低GPU频率可能使系统进入颠簸（thrashing）状态，此时内存压力会急剧恶化性能与能效。这些观察表明，面向智能体服务的功率优化需要重新设计。我们提出了KAIROS，一个面向智能体AI服务的上下文感知功率优化系统。KAIROS将智能体上下文作为一等控制信号，联合管理GPU频率、每实例并发度以及多实例请求放置，从而在存在内存余量时节省功率，同时避免……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: KAIROS提出将智能体上下文作为一等控制信号，联合管理GPU频率、每实例并发度与多实例请求放置，从而解决了传统降频方法在智能体AI服务中会引发内存颠簸、恶化性能与能效的问题，实现上下文感知的高效功率优化。
en_tdlr: KAIROS is a context-aware power optimization system for agentic AI serving that treats agent context as a first-class control signal to jointly manage GPU frequency, per-instance concurrency, and multi-instance request placement, saving power while avoiding the thrashing regime caused by naive frequency scaling.
